title: Grouping Heads in a Composition
content: "Alas, poor Yorick," scene fromHamletby Pascal Dagnan-BouveretCompositional tip: If you're staging a scene with more than two figures, overlap two of them, especially if those two are reacting to something.This illustration fromEmmaby Jane Austin byCharles and Henry BrockIn this scene from Jane Austin'sEmma,the two characters have been whispering to each other, and the tale is told from the point of view of the woman on the left. By bringing two of the faces close together, it's easier to see their reactions.
